title: Org demand
description: Anonymised open demand of the units the member belongs to. Carries no names and no free text, except the orders of the member's Logistician units under exchange.demand.details, which carry the order's requester handle and comment but never an assignee.

rawRefs.description: Raw ores that refine into this material; possibly empty.

source.description: Whether the line comes from a material order or from what an item order resolves to — never count item demand twice.

reason.description: Present only when the demand is withheld; both lists are then empty. NOT_PERMITTED: the member may not see their organisation's job orders. Absent when the member may see the demand, even if nothing is open. Treat an unknown value as withheld.

orders.description: Present only with exchange.demand.details and when the member is a Logistician of at least one unit they belong to: the open and in-progress orders those units are responsible for, by number. Absent otherwise, and when the demand is withheld. Orders of the member's other units stay summed in materials and items only.

order.description: One open or in-progress job order a unit the member is a Logistician of is responsible for, with what it still needs. Names no assignee.

id.description: The job order's id, as an org-stock earmark names it. Opaque.

number.description: The order's running number, shown as #number.

priority.description: The order's place in the Basetool's queue, 1 first; absent when it has none.

unit.description: The unit responsible for the order.

requestingUnit.description: The unit that placed the order and receives the goods.

handle.description: The requester as the order's author typed it: free text, not a member account. Absent when empty.

comment.description: The order's comment: free text. Absent when empty.

materials.description: Per material and quality floor, what this order still needs: its requirement less the stock linked to it, never below zero. For an item order, the materials its items resolve to. Lines with nothing open are left out.

items.description: Per game item, what an item order still needs: ordered less delivered less earmarked. Empty for a material order.

id.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.
